coverage: 435 voting U.S. House seats (50 states), 35 U.S. Senate seats (including FL/OH specials), 36 state governors. Does not include local/county, state legislative, judicial, territorial gubernatorial, or nonvoting congressional delegate contests.

source_refs.supports: 2020 census 50-state House seat allocation totaling 435. Geographic district boundaries and 2026 maps need separately verified.
2026 Senate election slate of 33 regular and 2 special (FL/OH)
36 state gubernatorial elections in 2026 (territories not included)
Candidate filings only; not certification of ballot placement

caveats: Race schedule and state allocations have been cross-checked against cited schedules, but district boundary and final ballot candidate verification are pending.
Some example candidate names from the prior prototype are retained ONLY as unverified draft entries. They must not be represented as ballot-certified.
No race win probabilities are provided or implied. Chamber-wide figures in the older prototype are also unverified.
This catalog excludes non-voting delegates from D.C. and territories as well as state, county, municipal, and local contests.
